entries.e497f18cf9c370b6: Its products fall into food products, namely seasonings, processed foods and frozen foods, and non-food products, namely amino acids for pharmaceutical and food use, contract development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients, and electronic materials. At the core of the food side is the umami seasoning “Ajinomoto®,” which traces back to the 1908 patent for a manufacturing method for monosodium glutamate seasoning, obtained by Dr. Kikunae Ikeda. On the non-food side, the current form has developed from the amino acid business, which began with essential amino acids for infusions launched in 1956; the chemical products business, which began in earnest in 1967 when it set up a chemical products department; and contract development and manufacturing, which started with Belgium’s Omnichem, acquired in full in 1989. In electronic materials, it handles interlayer insulating material for semiconductor packages, “ABF™,” and conducts research and development at its research laboratories and other facilities at the Kawasaki site (Kawasaki-ku, Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture).
entries.e52cd8730e792e55: A segment that earns revenue mainly from sales of frozen foods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥290,308 million (100.3% of the previous year); the company states that it was flat overall. Segment profit (business profit) was ¥8,457 million (65.0% of the previous year), a significant decrease mainly due to lower profit in North America. It is carried out by Ajinomoto Frozen Foods Co., Inc., Ajinomoto Foods North America, Inc. and Ajinomoto Frozen Foods France; the revenue of Ajinomoto Foods North America, Inc. (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies) exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. The number of employees is 5,348 (plus an annual average of 3,343 temporary employees).
entries.e5fd89df116bddfb: In December 1925, it newly established Suzuki Shoten Co., Ltd., transferred to it all of the business of the former Suzuki Shoten, a limited partnership, and Suzuki Shoten Co., Ltd., and dissolved both companies. The annual securities report records this as the "founding of the current Ajinomoto Co., Inc." After that, it changed its trade name to Ajinomoto Honpo Suzuki Shoten Co., Ltd. in October 1932, to Suzuki Shokuryo Kogyo Co., Ltd. in December 1940, to Dai Nippon Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. in May 1943, and became Ajinomoto Co., Ltd. in February 1946. In May 1949, it listed its shares.

entries.f10e79858e260182: The group consists of the company, 105 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 15 equity-method affiliates, and conducts businesses including seasonings, nutrition and processed foods, Solutions & Ingredients, frozen foods, amino acids for pharmaceutical and food use, Biopharma Services (CDMO), and Functional Materials (electronic materials, etc.). Its reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are organized mainly by product and are three in total: “Seasonings and Foods,” “Frozen Foods” and “Healthcare and Others.” The three food product categories (seasonings, nutrition and processed foods, and Solutions & Ingredients) and frozen foods are sold to general consumers and to food service and food processing businesses, whereas the Healthcare and Others segment, which consists of contract development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical companies and sales as an electronic materials manufacturer, is a different kind of business from food, with different customers. The company has set its purpose as “Contributing to the Well-being of people, society and the Earth through Amino Science®,” and takes a form in which everything from umami seasonings to pharmaceutical amino acids and electronic materials is connected through amino acid technology. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, by location of the selling company, was ¥571.7 billion in Japan and ¥1,011.9 billion overseas, with the overseas ratio at 63.9% (65.7% in the previous fiscal year).

(currently Ajinomoto (Malaysia) Berhad), in February 1968, Ajinomoto del Peru S.A., in July 1969, P.T. Ajinomoto Indonesia, and in December 1974, Ajinomoto Interamericana Industria e Comercio Ltda. (currently Ajinomoto do Brasil Industria e Comercio de Alimentos Ltda.).
